source_evidence.qualification_scope: Five source-qualified CVPR2026 main papers; source qualification is not runtime/capacity/legal redistribution approval.

paper.title: PFGNet: A Fully Convolutional Frequency-Guided Peripheral Gating Network for Efficient Spatiotemporal Predictive Learning

repository.official_link_evidence: Primary CVF/complete PDF and author repository qualification recorded in candidate_backbones.json; reused fixed source evidence, not a new author inertial implementation.

source_recheck.method: Each actual core raw file SHA/byte count verified and AST parsed, no upstream module imported. Fixed root LICENSE raw bytes fetched/hash matched and saved unmodified using apply_patch. Prior complete primary PDF qualification reused from source evidence; no datasets/weights fetched.

adaptation.selected_core: MSInit plus peripheral scale gating driven by temporal derivative/Laplacian/local variance, with source-style center suppression and GRN. No FFT substitution.
adaptation.draft_recipe_status: Explicit compact width/depth/patch/operator/initialization hypotheses; not original full visual-model profile, measured capacity, accuracy, latency or final-initialization parity.
adaptation.initialization: Temporal identity weights=ones/all channels; peripheral beta0; source GRN gamma1/beta0 and LayerScale1e-6. Other Conv weights retain PyTorch default instead of source PFG._init_params Kaiming; explicit initialization hypothesis.
adaptation.readout: Temporal mean of B,D,T features and one Linear(d_model,3) XYZ head.
keep: MSInit branch kernel labels3/5/7 with concatenated channel shares/remainder, GroupNorm1 and GELU
Peripheral learned large kernels9/15/31 minus tanh(beta)*central three-tap response
Three frequency cues feeding per-position softmax weights over peripheral scales
Source GRN x + gamma*x/(L2_time(x)+1e-6) + beta; gamma starts1, not a different ConvNeXt-V2 GRN
Source-style GroupNorm, SiLU-gated channel/value mixer with depthwise value conv and pointwise projections
Two residual branches with LayerScale initialized1e-6
replace: Spatial orthogonal-axis DW factors -> one temporal-axis large response, not two serial temporal kernels claiming equal receptive field
Spatial Sobel x/y -> single temporal first derivative [-1,0,1]; spatial Laplacian -> temporal [1,-2,1]; local spatial variance -> three-tap temporal variance
Source depthwise identity initialization -> explicit ones for EVERY temporal channel; original dirac call without groups may initialize only group0
SimVP T*C packing, spatial stem/image decoder -> Conv1d6->32,k3 no downsampling, MSInit/compact depth2 backbone, GAP/XYZ head
Source frame forecasting training objective -> scratch supervised average-velocity MSE
omitted: SimVP frame/channel packing and reconstruction decoder
Image spatial-axis adjacency or fictitious IMU-axis image geometry
Video prediction/forecasting objective and external future frames
Source full stage hierarchy and source convolution final initializer
paper_code_adapter_differences: 2D-to-1D frequency cues and geometry are explicit hypotheses, not original PFG_Model equivalence.
Port keeps PyTorch default Conv initialization; source PFG._init_params uses Kaiming initialization for block Conv. Formula retention does not imply initialization parity.
Temporal identity is initialized for all channels deliberately, fixing/adapting source dirac-without-group behavior rather than claiming exact source parity.
D32/depth2/MLP2 is a compact unmeasured draft, not source capacity or accuracy acceptance.
Arbitrary learned peripheral kernels are not guaranteed band-pass filters; neither noise removal nor physical inertial dynamics is established.
adaptation.objective: Shared plain supervised MSE over actual learned XYZ whole-window average velocity only; set_loss rejects non-MSE or kwargs. No source-task/SSL/teacher losses mixed into this identity.
adaptation.input_permissions: Same admitted reference_oracle six-axis task view as controls; no image/text/skeleton/geography/initial velocity/extra sensor/targets in forward/per-test fitting.
adaptation.temporal_scope: window_noncausal; only admitted T200 samples, no outside-window context or persistent fast weights/hidden state/maps.
risks: Center suppression can discard useful low-frequency gravity/bias information.
Temporal derivatives/local variance may amplify IMU noise.
Learned kernels require measured frequency-response checks; no automatic band-pass or trajectory-quality claim.

scientific_contract.output: vel:B,3 real supervised XYZ average velocity in m/s; no zero-padded Z
scientific_contract.xy_semantics: XY is the slice of the same XYZ prediction, no second XY model/head
scientific_contract.task_head: Temporal mean of B,D,T features and one Linear(d_model,3) XYZ head.
scientific_contract.optional_ssl_or_auxiliary_recipe: Not selected; any future source-specific loss requires separately named preregistered identity and budget.
